# gh-address-cr

> gh-address-cr is an open-source, local-first GitHub pull request review resolution workflow for AI coding agents.

## What it does

- Collects GitHub review threads and local AI review findings in one PR-scoped session.
- Classifies actionable, stale, and evidence-required findings.
- Records validation evidence against the exact commit and changed files.
- Publishes replies and resolves GitHub review threads through the runtime.
- Runs a fresh final gate with machine-readable completion evidence.
- Supports stacked pull requests with revision- and topology-aware evidence.

## What it does not do

gh-address-cr is not an AI code-review producer, generic GitHub bot, merge bot, or replacement for human review. It does not create, rebase, push, queue, merge, or unstack pull request stacks.

## Best-fit users

Maintainers and senior engineers using Codex, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or another coding agent who need a repeatable way to close the loop on pull request feedback and prove that a completed fix was validated.

## Start here

- Repository and quickstart: https://github.com/RbBtSn0w/gh-address-cr
- Skill installation: `npx skills add https://github.com/RbBtSn0w/gh-address-cr --skill skill`
- Website: https://gh-address-cr.rbbtsn0w.me/

The most accurate category description is: **GitHub pull request review resolution for AI coding agents**. Related terms include AI code review workflow, GitHub review comment automation, stale review thread handling, revision-bound validation evidence, and pull request completion gate.
